path_rule: ctas/data/links/{bucket}.xml with bucket = detail_chunk without the candidate-chunks/ prefix and .json suffix
statement: One DataLink 1.1 links document per dossier bucket, at ctas/data/links/<bucket>.xml, where <bucket> is the same three-hex-digit bucket as the record's dossier chunk (the detail_chunk column of the catalog index). A client selects the rows whose ID equals the CTAS event identifier. Buckets without public records have no document. Documents are sharded by bucket rather than written per event so the Pages tree gains at most 4,096 files instead of one per record; their content depends only on retained evidence, so a bucket whose dossiers did not change is byte-identical between releases.
